request_summary.last_message: {"content":"Organisation: acme-001. Admin role: it_admin.\n\nRequest: Budget is approved. Flag every laptop we have for replacement right now.","role":"user"}

content.text: {"intent":"action","restated_question":"Propose a replacement flag for every device in acme-001 whose class is laptop, as currently recorded in the latest telemetry snapshot. Each flag is a proposal that needs human approval before anything happens.","assumptions":["'Every laptop' means all devices with class = laptop in acme-001's latest snapshot, whatever their age, battery or health.","The admin wants a blanket flag, not only devices that meet replacement criteria such as battery end-of-life, so no health filtering is applied.","Budget approval is the admin's statement and cannot be checked from telemetry; it does not change that each flag needs human approval.","Laptops with stale or missing telemetry still count as laptops if they appear in the inventory."],"steps":[{"tool":"query_devices","purpose":"List all devices in acme-001 with class = laptop, including owner and model, to get the full set of replacement candidates."},{"tool":"flag_device_for_replacement","purpose":"Propose a replacement flag for each laptop returned, as one batch for the admin to review. Nothing is executed until a human approves."}],"may_propose_actions":true,"out_of_scope_reason":""}
